/* selectMasterWmGiProgressManageList */ SELECT X.BUYER_NAME, X.PO_NO, X.GR_NO, X.STDCATLG_ID, X.PO_CREATE_DATE, X.GR_DATE, X.DELIVERY_DATE, X.PO_QTY, X.WMS_IVK_QTY, X.LIST_PRICE, X.LIST_AMT, X.STATUS_TEXT, X.GUBUN_TEXT, X.LEGACY_PO_NO, X.IK_NO, X.BUYER_ITEM_NO, X.RD_DATE, X.INV_DATE, X.DOC_TEXT, X.WMS_GR_QTY, X.DELIVERY_QTY, X.UNIT_PRICE, X.UNIT_AMT, X.DESCRIPTION, X.SPECIFICATION, X.AGENT, X.AGENT_NAME, X.AGENT_TEL_NO AS AGENT_TEL_NO, X.GI_DELIVERY_QTY, X.ADD_USER_NAME, X.ADD_USER_ID, X.ADD_USER_TEL, X.DELY_TO_LOCATION, X.PO_REMARK, X.BUYER, X.PO_SEQ, X.BYIT_COMORG_CODE, X.CONTRACT_NO, X.CONTRACT_SEQ, X.GR_SEQ, X.IK_SEQ, X.PO_HD_REMARK, X.DOC_TYPE, X.MASTER_ITEM, X.IMG_NO, X.PODT_GR_QTY, X.PROCESS_TYPE, X.SCHEDULED_DATE, X.BOX_QTY, X.CAR_NO, X.CAR_PERSON_NAME, X.CAR_PERSON_TEL, X.DELAY_REMARK, X.MODIFIABLE, X.DELIVERY_COMPANY, (SELECT AUTO_GR_FLAG FROM KEP_BUYER_FLAG WHERE COM_CODE = X.BUYER) AS AUTO_GR_YN, ( SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'C019' AND CODE = X.DELIVERY_COMPANY ) AS DELIVERY_COMPANY_NAME, X.DELIVERY_NO, X.IMAGE_KEY_INV, X.IMAGE_KEY_INV_IMG, X.IMAGE_KEY_SIGN, X.IMAGE_KEY_SIGN_IMG, X.PR_USER_NAME, X.PR_USER_MOBILE_PHONE, X.WMS_RD_ID FROM (
SELECT
/*+USE_NL(PODT POHD) INDEX(PODT ICOMPODT_06)*/
(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, PODT.PO_NO AS PO_NO, IVDT.INV_NO AS GR_NO, PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS STDCATLG_ID, POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE AS PO_CREATE_DATE, IVDT.WMS_GR_DATE AS GR_DATE, '' AS DELIVERY_DATE, NVL(PODT.ITEM_QTY,0) AS PO_QTY, 0 AS WMS_IVK_QTY, DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'1',NVL(STCK.STC_SELLER_PRICE,0),NVL(PODT.AGENT_PRICE,0)) AS LIST_PRICE, (NVL(IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY,0) - NVL(IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY,0)) * NVL(PODT.AGENT_PRICE,0) AS LIST_AMT, DECODE(NVL(IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY,0),0,'출고예정','분할출고예정') AS STATUS_TEXT, PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, '' AS IK_NO, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, PODT.RD_DATE AS RD_DATE, '' AS INV_DATE, DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'1','재고','2','TR','3','VMI')||'('||DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'S','선입고','X','Kepmro','일반')||')' AS DOC_TEXT, DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'S','선입고','X','Kepmro','일반') GUBUN_TEXT, NVL(IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY,0) AS WMS_GR_QTY, 0 AS DELIVERY_QTY, NVL(PODT.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, (NVL(IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY,0) - NVL(IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY,0)) * NVL(PODT.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_AMT, PODT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, PODT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, POHD.AGENT AS AGENT, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, (SELECT TEL_NO FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT) AS AGENT_TEL_NO, NVL(IVDT.GR_QTY,0) AS GI_DELIVERY_QTY, PRDT.ADD_USER_NAME AS ADD_USER_NAME, '' AS ADD_USER_ID, PRDT.ADD_USER_TEL AS ADD_USER_TEL, POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, PODT.PO_REMARK AS PO_REMARK, POHD.BUYER AS BUYER, PODT.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PODT.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, PODT.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, IVDT.INV_SEQ AS GR_SEQ, '' AS IK_SEQ, POHD.PO_REMARK AS PO_HD_REMARK, POHD.DOC_TYPE AS DOC_TYPE, SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7) AS MASTER_ITEM, DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'X',(SELECT NVL(TRIM(IMG_NO),'0') FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7)),'') AS IMG_NO, 0 AS PODT_GR_QTY, '' AS MODIFIABLE, '' AS SCHEDULED_DATE, 0 AS BOX_QTY, '' AS CAR_NO, '' AS CAR_PERSON_NAME, '' AS CAR_PERSON_TEL, PODT.DELAY_REMARK, PODT.PROCESS_TYPE, '' AS DELIVERY_COMPANY, '' AS DELIVERY_NO, IVHD.IMAGE_KEY_INV, DECODE(IVHD.IMAGE_KEY_INV,'',5,6) AS IMAGE_KEY_INV_IMG, IVHD.IMAGE_KEY_SIGN, DECODE(IVHD.IMAGE_KEY_SIGN,'',5,6) AS IMAGE_KEY_SIGN_IMG, PRHD.CHANGE_USER_NAME AS PR_USER_NAME, PRHD.CHANGE_USER_TEL AS PR_USER_MOBILE_PHONE, ( SELECT MIN(IMP.SLG_ID) FROM BNTSLGIMP IMP, BNTSLGDEF DEF WHERE 1=1 AND IMP.SLG_ID = DEF.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN IMP.OPEN_DATE AND IMP.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN DEF.OPEN_DATE AND DEF.CLOSE_DATE AND IMP.COL01_DATA LIKE '%' || POHD.BUYER ||'%' ) AS WMS_RD_ID, '' AS LEGACY_IV_SERIAL FROM ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPRDT PRDT, ICOMIVDT IVDT, WMSSTCK STCK, ICOMIVHD IVHD, ICOMPRHD PRHD WHERE POHD.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ AND PRDT.BUYER = PRHD.BUYER AND PRDT.PR_NO = PRHD.PR_NO AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND IVDT.BUYER = IVHD.BUYER AND IVDT.INV_NO = IVHD.INV_NO AND STCK.WAREHOUSE_CODE(+) = '${st_warehouse_code}' AND STCK.STDCATLG_ID(+) = PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID AND STCK.AGENT(+) = DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'1','KRKORE0001','3',PODT.WAREHOUSE_CODE) AND POHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY <> IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY
AND (PODT.RD_DATE < '${st_from_date}' AND PODT.RD_DATE > '${st_to_date}')
AND PODT.RD_DATE BETWEEN '${st_from_date}' AND '${st_to_date}'
AND (PODT.RD_DATE < '${st_from_date}' AND PODT.RD_DATE > '${st_to_date}')
AND WIDT.SCHEDULED_DATE BETWEEN '${st_from_date}' AND '${st_to_date}'
AND PODT.BUYER IN
'${st_buyer_code}'
AND (PODT.PO_NO LIKE '${st_po_no}'||'%' OR PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO LIKE '${st_po_no}'||'%')
AND IVDT.INV_NO LIKE '${st_inv_no}'||'%'
AND POHD.AGENT = '${st_agent_code}'
AND PODT.PO_NO LIKE '${st_ik_no}'||'%'
AND (PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '${st_buyer_item_no}'||'%' OR PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID LIKE '${st_buyer_item_no}'||'%')
AND PODT.PROCESS_TYPE IN
'${st_process_type}'
AND IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY <> 0 AND IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY <> IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY
AND IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY <> 0 AND IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY <> IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY
UNION ALL
SELECT
/*+USE_NL(PODT POHD) INDEX(PODT ICOMPODT_06)*/
/*+LEADING(WIDT)*/
(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, PODT.PO_NO AS PO_NO, WIDT.S_INV_NO AS GR_NO, PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS STDCATLG_ID, POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE AS PO_CREATE_DATE, WIDT.GR_DATE AS GR_DATE, WIDT.DELIVERY_DATE AS DELIVERY_DATE, NVL(PODT.ITEM_QTY,0) AS PO_QTY, NVL(WIDT.INV_QTY,0) AS WMS_IVK_QTY, DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'1',NVL(WIDT.LIST_PRICE,0),NVL(PODT.AGENT_PRICE,0)) AS LIST_PRICE, NVL((NVL(WIDT.INV_QTY,0) * NVL(PODT.AGENT_PRICE,0)),0) AS LIST_AMT, DECODE(WIDT.INV_QTY,WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY,'배송확정',DECODE(IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY,WIDT.INV_QTY,'출고','분할출고')) AS STATUS_TEXT, PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, WIDT.INV_NO AS IK_NO, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, PODT.RD_DATE AS RD_DATE, WIDT.INV_DATE AS INV_DATE, DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'1','재고','2','TR','3','VMI')||'('||DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'S','선입고','X','Kepmro','일반')||')' AS DOC_TEXT, DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'S','선입고','X','Kepmro','일반') AS GUBUN_TEXT, NVL(WIDT.GR_QTY,0) AS WMS_GR_QTY, DECODE(WIDT.INV_QTY,WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY,WIDT.INV_QTY,0) AS DELIVERY_QTY, NVL(PODT.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL((NVL(WIDT.INV_QTY,0) * NVL(PODT.UNIT_PRICE,0)),0) AS UNIT_AMT, PODT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, PODT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, POHD.AGENT AS AGENT, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT)AS AGENT_NAME, (SELECT TEL_NO FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT) AS AGENT_TEL_NO, NVL(IVDT.GR_QTY,0) AS GI_DELIVERY_QTY, PRDT.ADD_USER_NAME AS ADD_USER_NAME, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = WIDT.ADD_USER_ID) ADD_USER_ID,PRDT.ADD_USER_TEL AS ADD_USER_TEL, POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, PODT.PO_REMARK AS PO_REMARK, POHD.BUYER AS BUYER, PODT.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PODT.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, PODT.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, WIDT.S_INV_SEQ AS GR_SEQ, WIDT.INV_SEQ AS IK_SEQ, POHD.PO_REMARK AS PO_HD_REMARK, POHD.DOC_TYPE AS DOC_TYPE, SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7) AS MASTER_ITEM, DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'X',(SELECT NVL(TRIM(IMG_NO),'0') FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7)),'') AS IMG_NO, NVL(PODT.GR_QTY,0) AS PODT_GR_QTY, CASE WHEN WIDT.PROCESS_TYPE = '2' THEN 'Y' WHEN SUBSTR(WIDT.DELIVERY_DATE, 1, 6) >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') THEN 'Y' WHEN SUBSTR(WIDT.DELIVERY_DATE, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1), 'YYYYMM') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DD') <= '06' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS MODIFIABLE, WIDT.SCHEDULED_DATE, WIDT.BOX_QTY, WIDT.CAR_NO, WIDT.CAR_PERSON_NAME, WIDT.CAR_PERSON_TEL, PODT.DELAY_REMARK, PODT.PROCESS_TYPE, WIDT.DELIVERY_COMPANY, WIDT.DELIVERY_NO, WIDT.IMAGE_KEY_INV, DECODE(WIDT.IMAGE_KEY_INV,'',5,6) AS IMAGE_KEY_INV_IMG, WIDT.IMAGE_KEY_SIGN, DECODE(WIDT.IMAGE_KEY_SIGN,'',5,6) AS IMAGE_KEY_SIGN_IMG, PRHD.CHANGE_USER_NAME AS PR_USER_NAME, PRHD.CHANGE_USER_TEL AS PR_USER_MOBILE_PHONE, ( SELECT MIN(IMP.SLG_ID) FROM BNTSLGIMP IMP, BNTSLGDEF DEF WHERE 1=1 AND IMP.SLG_ID = DEF.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN IMP.OPEN_DATE AND IMP.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN DEF.OPEN_DATE AND DEF.CLOSE_DATE AND IMP.COL01_DATA LIKE '%' || POHD.BUYER ||'%' ) AS WMS_RD_ID, WIDT.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL AS LEGACY_IV_SERIAL FROM ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPRDT PRDT, ICOMIVDT IVDT, WMSIVDT WIDT, ICOMPRHD PRHD WHERE POHD.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ AND PRDT.BUYER = PRHD.BUYER AND PRDT.PR_NO = PRHD.PR_NO AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND IVDT.BUYER = WIDT.BUYER AND IVDT.INV_NO = WIDT.S_INV_NO AND IVDT.INV_SEQ = WIDT.S_INV_SEQ AND POHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND WIDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND (PODT.WAREHOUSE_CODE = '${st_warehouse_code}' OR POHD.AGENT= '${st_warehouse_agent}')
AND WIDT.INV_DATE BETWEEN '${st_from_date}' AND '${st_to_date}'
AND PODT.RD_DATE BETWEEN '${st_from_date}' AND '${st_to_date}'
AND WIDT.DELIVERY_DATE BETWEEN '${st_from_date}' AND '${st_to_date}'
AND WIDT.SCHEDULED_DATE BETWEEN '${st_from_date}' AND '${st_to_date}'
AND PODT.BUYER IN
'${st_buyer_code}'
AND (PODT.PO_NO LIKE '${st_po_no}'||'%' OR PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO LIKE '${st_po_no}'||'%')
AND IVDT.INV_NO LIKE '${st_inv_no}'||'%'
AND POHD.AGENT = '${st_agent_code}'
AND WIDT.INV_NO LIKE '${st_ik_no}'||'%'
AND (PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '${st_buyer_item_no}'||'%' OR PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID LIKE '${st_buyer_item_no}'||'%')
AND PODT.PROCESS_TYPE IN
'${st_process_type}'
AND WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY = 0
AND WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY = 0 AND IVDT.INV_QTY <> WIDT.INV_QTY
AND WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY <> 0 AND WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY = WIDT.INV_QTY
UNION ALL
SELECT
/*+USE_NL(PODT POHD) INDEX(PODT ICOMPODT_06)*/
(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, PODT.PO_NO AS PO_NO, HUB.S_INV_NO AS GR_NO, PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS STDCATLG_ID, POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE AS PO_CREATE_DATE, TO_CHAR(HUB.HUB_GR_CREATE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS GR_DATE, '' AS DELIVERY_DATE, NVL(PODT.ITEM_QTY,0) AS PO_QTY, NVL(HUB.HUB_IV_QTY,0) AS WMS_IVK_QTY, 0 AS LIST_PRICE, 0 AS LIST_AMT, '간선출고' AS STATUS_TEXT, PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, '' AS IK_NO, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, PODT.RD_DATE AS RD_DATE, TO_CHAR(HUB.HUB_GR_CREATE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS INV_DATE, '간선' || '(' || (SELECT TEXT7 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='W001' AND FLAG='Y' AND TEXT4='B' AND TEXT1=HUB.ARRV_CENTER) || ')' AS DOC_TEXT, '간선' || '(' || (SELECT TEXT7 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='W001' AND FLAG='Y' AND TEXT4='B' AND TEXT1=HUB.ARRV_CENTER) || ')' AS GUBUN_TEXT, NVL(HUB.HUB_GR_QTY,0) AS WMS_GR_QTY, 0 AS DELIVERY_QTY, NVL(PODT.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL((NVL(HUB.HUB_GR_QTY,0) * NVL(PODT.UNIT_PRICE,0)),0) AS UNIT_AMT, PODT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, PODT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, POHD.AGENT AS AGENT, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT)AS AGENT_NAME, (SELECT TEL_NO FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT) AS AGENT_TEL_NO, NVL(IVDT.GR_QTY,0) AS GI_DELIVERY_QTY, PRDT.ADD_USER_NAME AS ADD_USER_NAME, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = HUB.HUB_GR_USER_ID) ADD_USER_ID, PRDT.ADD_USER_TEL AS ADD_USER_TEL, POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, PODT.PO_REMARK AS PO_REMARK, POHD.BUYER AS BUYER, PODT.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PODT.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, PODT.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, HUB.S_INV_SEQ AS GR_SEQ, '' AS IK_SEQ, POHD.PO_REMARK AS PO_HD_REMARK, POHD.DOC_TYPE AS DOC_TYPE, SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7) AS MASTER_ITEM, DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'X',(SELECT NVL(TRIM(IMG_NO),'0') FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7)),'') AS IMG_NO, NVL(PODT.GR_QTY,0) AS PODT_GR_QTY, 'N' AS MODIFIABLE, HUB.SCHEDULED_DATE, HUB.TOT_BOX_QTY AS BOX_QTY, '' AS CAR_NO, '' AS CAR_PERSON_NAME, '' AS CAR_PERSON_TEL, PODT.DELAY_REMARK, PODT.PROCESS_TYPE, '' AS DELIVERY_COMPANY, '' AS DELIVERY_NO, '' AS IMAGE_KEY_INV, 5 AS IMAGE_KEY_INV_IMG, '' AS IMAGE_KEY_SIGN, 5 AS IMAGE_KEY_SIGN_IMG, PRHD.CHANGE_USER_NAME AS PR_USER_NAME, PRHD.CHANGE_USER_TEL AS PR_USER_MOBILE_PHONE, '' AS WMS_RD_ID, '' AS LEGACY_IV_SERIAL FROM ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPRDT PRDT, ICOMIVDT IVDT, HUBIVDT HUB, ICOMPRHD PRHD WHERE POHD.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ AND PRDT.BUYER = PRHD.BUYER AND PRDT.PR_NO = PRHD.PR_NO AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND IVDT.BUYER = HUB.BUYER AND IVDT.INV_NO = HUB.S_INV_NO AND IVDT.INV_SEQ = HUB.S_INV_SEQ AND POHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND HUB.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.HUB_FLAG = 'C' AND PODT.PROCESS_TYPE = '2' AND HUB.DEPT_CENTER = '${st_warehouse_code}' AND HUB.HUB_IV_QTY = HUB.HUB_GR_QTY
AND 1=0
AND HUB.HUB_IV_DATE BETWEEN '${st_from_date}' AND '${st_to_date}'
AND PODT.RD_DATE BETWEEN '${st_from_date}' AND '${st_to_date}'
AND HUB.HUB_IV_DATE BETWEEN '${st_from_date}' AND '${st_to_date}'
AND HUB.SCHEDULED_DATE BETWEEN '${st_from_date}' AND '${st_to_date}'
AND PODT.BUYER IN
'${st_buyer_code}'
AND (PODT.PO_NO LIKE '${st_po_no}'||'%' OR PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO LIKE '${st_po_no}'||'%')
AND IVDT.INV_NO LIKE '${st_inv_no}'||'%'
AND POHD.AGENT = '${st_agent_code}'
AND IVDT.INV_NO LIKE '${st_ik_no}'||'%'
AND (PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '${st_buyer_item_no}'||'%' OR PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID LIKE '${st_buyer_item_no}'||'%')
) X
ORDER BY X.RD_DATE DESC, X.BUYER_NAME, X.PO_NO DESC, X.PO_SEQ
ORDER BY X.BUYER_NAME, X.PO_NO DESC, X.PO_SEQ
ORDER BY X.AGENT, X.BUYER_NAME, X.PO_NO DESC, X.PO_SEQ
ORDER BY X.PO_NO DESC, X.PO_SEQ, X.BUYER_NAME
ORDER BY X.GR_NO, X.BUYER_NAME, X.PO_NO DESC, X.PO_SEQ
ORDER BY X.IK_NO, X.BUYER_NAME, X.PO_NO DESC, X.PO_SEQ
